title: Run indexes: by agent, and 'needs attention'
description:
Two indexes on `ProcedureRun`, added in two releases because a deploy adds one index per table: (1) `automationId` + `requestedAt`, so an agent's runs are one query; (2) a sparse `attentionKey` + `dueAt`, present only while a run is `waiting`, `unknown` or `failed` and unacknowledged, so Today and the overdue check read only what needs a person. Remove the code paths that load every `ProcedureRun` (`procedure-action` `listModelPages` and its full-list path when an index query is missing).

**Acceptance criteria**
- An agent's run history is one indexed query.
- A run that needs nobody is not in the attention index.
- No code path lists the whole `ProcedureRun` table.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- run-indexes.feature: an agent's runs are listed newest first by index; an acknowledged failure leaves the attention list; the run list never reads the whole table (request meter shows no unbounded list).

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Amplify data schema: two GSIs on `ProcedureRun`, one per release.

**Part of:** Wake contract and run outcomes. Slice code A5 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
